scope: Native cancellation boundary audit for G1 consumer changes; no production cancellation implementation or gate claimed
decision: Do not use tick-function +D disabling or a zero physics delta as a cancellation substitute. The task wrapper completes/recycles after a callback or disabled branch, while zero-delta physics returns before creating its completion event. Neither proves cancellation of an already active application or permits skipping required callbacks. Existing complete-B/native/GPU guards retained.
